posts.name: skoticus
posts.cooked:
There are a few things that I am hoping come with the last expansion, and I was curious what other people might also be looking for. Obviously, we all want hero versions of every villan and vice versa, but I mean little conveniences.

I think a lot of people are already getting their wish with the storage solution, but surely there are other little things that might be helpful!

 

Here's some things I'm hoping for:

-A single page that lists all heroes, villains, environements with their difficulties. 

-That the Promo Pack either doesn't come with unique promos, or, if it does, those ones are available seperately. I've already got all the other promos, so I don't feel like I need to double up--but I also know I'll be compelled to get it anyhow if there are unique promos. (Just like I did with  the Oversized Villains Cards)

posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked:
1) I'd like to have the full story finally explained, perhaps in a booklet that comes with the expansion.  There are story twists that I'm sure normal (i.e. non-hardcore) players of the game have missed but which are really cool and should be explained more thoroughly.  It's a shame to let all of Christopher's intricate story work go unobserved by so many players.

2) I'd like many, many alt. character cards.  I love those and this seems like the perfect time to put out a bunch of them.  It sounds like some version of this may already be on the plate.

3) I'd love to have many of the decks in the final expansions be Sentinels-style decks made of multiple characters, but with them being teams of villains or teams of multiverse alts.  That would be a good way to make it feel like you're bringing a huge roster of characters to the fight, with multiple characters per deck, but still not having more than 5 decks per fight.

However, if #3 interferes with #2, I'd rather have #2.  Hundreds of alt. character cards FTW.
